Name: Configurable Farm Cave Extension
Author: BoogieBest
Description:
[center]works with the new SDV 1.5

Hello my dear modding aficionados!

This is a small overhaul of the farm cave. The goal is to add a little more use to the cave and give the player more space to store/produce goods. It tries to blend into the vanilla game (reasonable size and look).

What does it do: (see pictures)

- The cave gets a little extension to the right side, to give the player a little more space for stuff.
- Elevator to a second, deeper level: This are offers space for about 50+ tiles.
- fully configurable: choose which version do you want, all ingame with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

Versions:
- New version (see pictures)
- Old version (see pictures)

All versions can be configured:
- with cobblestone path
- with cobblestone area
- no cobblestone path at all

I made for myself the version with the cobblestone path, since the light setting in the cave made the placeable path look kind of out-of-place.

UPDATE LOG:
v 1.1:
- new configurable version changed the first floor a little bit (see pictures).
- old and new version: the elevator teleporter works on your way up like a regular exit ( warp on touch, not warp on action = only run into it, no need to activate it). I made this change, because it feels more intuitive with the rest of the game (which always does it like that in this situations).
- new floor added: cobbelstone area. i liked the cobbelstone path from the original but wanted something to look more organic. I took inspiration of the flooring on mine level 100 etc.
- some minor design changes in walls and graphics.
- extended the distance between 1st floor and 2nd floor on the .tbin map , for people who play on max zoom out (so they dont see the other area).
v 1.0:
Release

INSTALLATION:
1. make sure to download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional but recommended.
2. download the  FarmCave_Expansion.rar
3. unzip/extract it
4. place the "[CP] Boogie Farm Cave Expansion" folder into your Mods folder.
5. Configuration.json gets created after first start with the mod. You can edit the settings via Generic Mod Config Menu if you have it installed.
6. feedback is welcome, enjoy :)!

UPDATE GUIDE:
1. Remove everything from the farm cave and save and close the game. I extended the distance between 1st floor and 2nd floor on the .tbin map , for people who play on max zoom out (so they dont see the other area). THATS WHY you need to first remove your stuff before updating, even if you keep the original layout! (positions change)
2. Overwrite the previous files (see INSTALLATION).
3. Put everything back.

DEINSTALLATION:
1. remove all things you placed insinde the new area.
2. safe the game.
3. delete the "[CP] Boogie Farm Cave Expansion" folder inside your mods.

COMPATIBILITY:
Works with everything that does not edit/replace the FarmCave.tbin Map.

KNOW ISSUES:
1. When you update from Version 1.0 to 1.1 remove everything inside, since i changed the position of the map. Otherwise your stuff might not be acessible.
2. No bugs so far.

Thanks for your download, enjoy and let me know if you have any suggestions or find bugs!
